tools.name: domain-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP registration data (registrar, status, dates, nameservers, contacts) for a domain name.

tools.name: bulk-domain-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP registration data for several domain names in one pooled call. Requires a Pro or Business plan; every domain in the batch counts against the quota.

tools.name: ip-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP allocation data (network range, holder, country, status) for an IP address or CIDR block.

tools.name: asn-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP data (holder, country, status, registration dates) for an autonomous system number.

tools.name: nameserver-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP data (IP addresses, status, sponsoring registrar) for a nameserver hostname.

tools.name: entity-lookup
tools.description: Look up normalized RDAP data for an RIR entity handle — an organization or contact identifier such as "GOGL" or "ORG-RIEN1-RIPE". Only ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC and AFRINIC handles resolve; a domain's registrar or registrant comes from domain-lookup instead.

tools.name: tlds
tools.description: List the TLDs this API can query, or describe one: which RDAP server answers for it, since when it has been supported, and how often that server fills each field. Metadata, so it never counts against the monthly quota.
